description: This file provides utility function declarations and macros for Wi-Fi management within the Zephyr project, including parsing Wi-Fi bands, SSIDs, and channels, as well as validating channels for different frequency bands.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_bands
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of Wi-Fi bands ('2', '5', '6') and converts it into a bitmap.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_ssids
methods.description: Appends SSID strings to an array from a comma-separated list.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_chan
methods.description: Parses a complex string specifying Wi-Fi channels and ranges into an array of channel structures.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan
methods.description: Validates if a channel is valid for a given band.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_2g
methods.description: Checks if a channel is valid in the 2.4 GHz band.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_5g
methods.description: Checks if a channel is valid in the 5 GHz band.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_6g
methods.description: Checks if a channel is valid in the 6 GHz band.
